title: Administrative Assistants
description:
M-F 8 hours daily
.30 minute Unpaid Lunch Break
No Holiday work, Overtime or travel required
Free Parking Provided

General duties:

• Answer, screen and transfer incoming phone calls to appropriate BFD staff.

• Receive and direct visitors and clients.

• Perform general clerical duties including photocopying, fax, scan, and mailings as delegated.

• Maintain electronic and hard copy filing systems in both the P-drive and in the bureau's

designated file room.

• Retrieve documents from filing system as requested.

• Complete requests for information and data by staff.

• Prepare letters of good standing and license verifications for the BFD Director's signature.

• Open, sort and distribute incoming correspondence.

• Maintain office supply inventories.

• Coordinate requests for maintenance of office equipment.

• Maintain Excel spreadsheets for the monthly website updates for Open Firms, Closed Firms,

Registered Residents and active Licensed Funeral Directors.

• Process cash-lined checks for submission to the Bureau of Accounts Management.

• Prepare and assemble registered resident packets for mailing to applicants.

Prepare the law exam candidate information packets for distribution to applicants.

• Perform other duties as requested by BFD staff.

The successful candidate should be reliable, dependable, punctual, highly motivated, detail-oriented and be able to function efficiently and effectively in a fast-paced work environment.

Minimum qualifications

• include a High School Diploma (or equivalent)

• one (1) year minimum experience working in an office setting

• excellent working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications (specifically Word, Excel,

PowerPoint, and Outlook)

• the ability to handle multiple, shifting priorities

• strong organizational and communication skills (written and verbal)

• maintain, and work with electronic databases and systems

Preferred qualifications

• Bachelor's Degree or higher

• Strong verbal communications skills

• Ability to handle multiple tasks

• Experience with Excel, Outlook, Word, tracking as well as scheduling of meetings.

Salary commensurate with scope of work job experience
Proper footwear required to perform tasks in a safe manner.
Perform other reasonably related duties as required.
New Wave People is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO).

title: Radiologic Technologists
description:
M-F 8a - 4p 
.30 Minute Lunch Break
No Holiday work, Overtime or travel required
Free Parking Provided

Radiologic Technologists
An experienced full-time xray technologist is needed to complete radilogy studies on individual at Bedford Hills Correctional Facility.

May include the following:
Radiologic Technologists are distinguished by assignments calling for direct physical contact with patients in the performance of radiological examinations and the administration of radiotherapy treatments at the prescription and direction of radiologists, roentgenologist and other physicians. Radiologic Technologists operate x-ray and fluorographic equipment in the performance of a full range of observational and diagnostic tests.
Must possess a valid degree and New York State licensure.

Salary commensurate with scope of work job experience
Proper footwear required to perform tasks in a safe manner.
Perform other reasonably related duties as required.

title: Registered Dietitian Nutritionist
description:
M-F 8A-4:30P - Firm Shift
.30 Minute Unpaid Meal Break
No Holiday work, Overtime or travel required
Free Parking Provided
 
Job Duties: Perform comprehensive nutrition screenings and assessments. Develop and implement individualized Medical
Nutrition Therapy(MNT) plans. Document nutrition assessments, interventions, and outcomes within the electronic medical
record. Provide nutrition groups, education and counseling to patients, families, and caregivers. Participate in facility-wide and
departmental Quality Assurance and Performance Improvement initiatives. Participate in multidisciplinary patient care rounds
and departmental meetings. Support staff development initiatives and contribute to improved clinical outcomes. Complete
Swallowing Screen as needed.

Minimum requirements, including licenses and certifications: Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Clinical Nutrition, Dietetics, or a related field from an accredited institution. AND Registered Dietitian (RD) or Registered Dietitian Nutritionist (RDN) credential.

Salary commensurate with scope of work job experience
Proper footwear required to perform tasks in a safe manner.
Perform other reasonably related duties as required.
New Wave People is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO).
